group.CloudGame.label: Cloud Game
task_cloud_game_desc: Run python agent/cloud_start.py --client <path to NTECloudGame.exe> (or start the client manually), then select Cloud NTE - Front. This task waits for login, verification and authorization, then handles starting, playtime confirmation, queueing and in-game handoff according to your options, and closes recognized daily login popups. Closing a popup is not actively claiming playtime; no playtime purchases, paid queues or credential reading/storage are performed. The client shell uses background input, but in-game scene controls still require an interactive desktop: keep it unlocked and connected. Automatic clicks are blocked if the current environment fails resource calibration checks; passing calibration does not establish real-client end-to-end validation.
cloud_game_daily_login_unresolved: Cannot identify the daily-login popup close button. Handle it manually
cloud_game_login_expired: Cloud login expired. Log in again in the client
task_cloud_game_option_auto_queue_desc: Enabled by default. Enter the game and wait in the cloud client's queue after login; never buys play time, activates a pass or speeds up the queue. Disable it for manual entry.
task_cloud_game_option_queue_timeout_des: Stop safely when the timeout expires; never repeat clicks or spend on a paid queue.
cloud_game_daily_login_closed: Daily login popup closed; this is not an active playtime claim
cloud_game_manual_enter: Auto queue is disabled. Enter the game manually in the Cloud NTE window.
cloud_game_start_failed: Cloud NTE startup failed; check the window and login state
cloud_game_window_handoff_required: Cloud NTE switched to a new game window; reconnect the game window before running again

task_fish_new_desc:
Redesigned fishing feature. In theory, you can now fish indefinitely.
It is still not possible to directly resume overnight fishing sessions that have been interrupted by the monthly pass. You can try setting up a scheduled task to continue fishing, but results are not guaranteed.
The fishing feature only hack-on and uses the mouse for automatically buying bait and selling fish.
The auto-buy bait function purchases bait or switches to universal bait when it detects a shortage (the bait detection threshold is unrelated to this task), and the auto-sell function attempts to sell fish when Fish Scale Coins are low.

task_gift_limit_desc: Choose 1–3 (default 3), the cumulative target for today rather than extra gifts this run. Repeated runs read the game's existing count and only fill the shortfall. At most 10 total per day, subject to the game.
task_gift_priority_input: Full gift names or IDs (separate with >)
task_gift_dry_run_desc: Only checks characters, candidate gifts, inventory and in-game counts, then shows the plan. Never presses the final gift confirmation or consumes gifts or attempts.
pretask_cloud_web_desc: Before connecting the Cloud Game - Web controller, opens (or reuses) the Cloud NTE page in a dedicated browser profile and waits for its window. Your everyday browser data is never read.
task_cloud_web_desc: Select the Cloud Game - Web controller and start: opens the Cloud NTE page in a dedicated browser, checks login and remaining play time, picks the recommended node, confirms play time, queues automatically, then handles in-game login and popups until the main game screen. You are asked to log in manually when needed; play time, passes and credentials are never bought or filled in. The web stage runs through the browser's debugging interface without an interactive desktop; the stream needs working UDP to mainland China, so allow it if you use a TUN proxy such as Clash/Mihomo.
task_cloud_web_option_auto_queue_desc: On by default. Enters the game queue after login and play-time checks; when off, the task stops there for manual entry.
task_cloud_web_option_login_timeout_desc: How long to wait for you to log in in the browser (1–120); stops safely afterwards.
task_cloud_web_option_queue_timeout_desc: After this many minutes (1–1440) the task clicks Leave Queue and stops, so an unattended session does not consume play time.
task_cloud_web_option_fullscreen_desc: On by default. Switches the browser to fullscreen once streaming, so later tasks capture a 16:9 frame without a title bar.
cloud_web_focus_done: Cloud NTE reached the main game screen
cloud_web_focus_manual: Auto queue is off; enter the game manually in the browser
cloud_web_focus_failed: Cloud NTE (Web) startup failed; see the log above
task_gift_plan_count_desc: Choose how many plans to configure (default 1). Plans run in row order; select each character, gifts and cumulative daily target separately.
task_gift_recipient_row_desc: Search for a character. Choose different characters for different plans. Repeated characters share their gifts and limit and run only once.
task_gift_priority_mode_desc: Choose primary and backup gifts from the list, or enter a complete priority list. Saved text values remain available in manual mode.
task_gift_primary_desc: Search by gift name. Use the primary gift until stock is exhausted before trying backups. No gift is selected by default.
task_gift_backup_desc: Optional second choice after the primary is exhausted. Only selected gifts are used; there are no automatic substitutions.
task_gift_extra_desc: Third and later choices: separate full names or IDs with >, with no length limit. Used in this order after the primary and backup are exhausted.
